parameterFixtureFailures: Root smoke v1 used the wrong anchor schema and failed admission before mechanics; corrected v2 passes.

Work test native v2 used a high-energy anchor-normalization comparison whose valid error bound covered the intended signal. A cancellation fixture isolates a positive approximately 1.38778e-5 J signal; native v3 passes. No producer repair was required for that test fixture.
developmentHistory.parameterPrecisionImprovement: The first equal-target crossing probe reported valid zero work with nonzero uncertainty. Combining identical target functionals before boundary bounding now preserves an exact zero bound; irrelevant inactive-old-target margins no longer consume boundary depth. Prior bounds were conservative, not false certificates.
developmentHistory.referenceLabelRepair: The historical exact-cancellation comparison overwrote differenceFromHighPrecisionReference with zero based on structural algebra, while retaining a 3.66E-168 numerical quadrature residue. The reduction corrects the numerical difference field, preserves the historical override separately, and names algebraic cancellation as the verification basis. Raw review evidence and mechanical code are unchanged.
developmentHistory.scheduleFixtureFailures: Initial schedule tests had two oracle/fixture errors: a generated 65-knot target became negative, and the expected large-grid activation minimum used the wrong ramp slope. Corrected focused tests pass; neither changed producer behavior.
developmentHistory.scheduleMetadataMutation: Independent review found readonly ndarray storage still allowed mutable strides/shape/dtype metadata. The stopped first full run is not a pass. Final storage uses immutable numerical bytes/shape with disposable views; final tests and a separate before/after review retain the attack and fix.

limitations: Supplied-state work-only comparison, no dynamics or source construction.
Decimal32/64-node comparisons are numerical references, not certified quadrature bounds.
Whole-taut and cancellation analytic comparisons use independent directed rational sqrt/log bounds.
Exact structural zero is checked independently, not inferred from small Decimal residue.
Shared-Q model uses the original numerical anchor coefficients and exact measure; no calibration claim.
One exact-cancellation total uses algebraic zero as its verification basis; the nonzero retained numerical quadrature residue is explicitly outside the zero-width producer interval.
independentWorkReview.omitted: Full supplied cells, position/parameter arrays, long decimal reference values and root partitions remain in the ignored source artifact. Published bounds, numerical differences and directed analytic checks remain here.

decisions: Explicit route distinct from existing fixed control, exact initial numerical parameter match and no implicit initial jump.
One immutable potential at the original end fraction per trial; resample original fractions during retries.
Parameter work at q_before followed by new-control motion work; retain separate errors and avoid double counting parameter uncertainty in balances that subtract the same work.
Fresh response/work identity checks and final report/core/control snapshots before accepted publication.

independentReviewLimitations: The reduced mass m/2 accounts for relative kinetic energy; the center-of-mass velocity is constant and chosen zero in these fixtures.
Nonnegative defects follow from this convex scalar potential and backward Euler, not a universal inequality for nonconvex cloth/contact.
Numerical attenuation is not calibrated material damping, physical settling, temporal convergence, or continuous-time actuator work.
exactBalanceOracle.scope: Exact scalar equal-mass backward-Euler arithmetic for prospective integration, including slack crossings. No solver or cloth/contact/source trajectory is executed. Nonnegative backward-Euler defects are numerical attenuation, not calibrated damping.

prospectiveGenericIntegration.reviewTiming: Documents and prospective design reviewed before terminal full-suite completion; final counts/logs are checked separately by the final ledger audit.
prospectiveGenericIntegration.scope: Prospective requirements only; no integration or motion is implemented by the design note.

remainingGates: Integrate varying cable controls into the generic guarded solver/adaptive continuation and complete parameter-plus-motion energy publication.
Bind construction-specific source joints and controls; obtain joint spatial/temporal seam evidence.
Refined capture/main-replay admission remains unapplied pending specific authorization; no direct-API bypass.
Execute and validate binding wrap/finish/apex and cuff turning through the reserved opening.
Establish temporal/spatial convergence, material/damping/friction and body/contact evidence.
Complete all shirt fabric/interfacing roles and full-shirt application acceptance; app remains placement inspection.
Remote push remains pending separate authorization; local verification does not authorize publication or deployment.

scheduleIndependentReview.countPolicy: The independent 22 probes and producer 12 probes are separate checks, with overlapping attack types; do not add them as distinct unittest methods.
scheduleIndependentReview.scope: Static independent sampling, metadata mutation and reinitialization probes only; no force, work or motion

schedulePolicy.capture: Strict raw JSON values, shapes and ranges before capture/allocation; detached description; immutable internal numeric storage and disposable views.
schedulePolicy.gridPreflight: For each monotone interval/cell inspect endpoints and a grid point adjacent to each zero endpoint. The minimum positive rounded activation and its exact beta admit every point on the named finite retry grid without enumerating that grid.
schedulePolicy.initialState: Standalone declarations may start away from the base initial parameters; no initial jump is executed or accounted. Future integration must explicitly require a match or account for the jump.
schedulePolicy.interpolation: Original exact dyadic fraction and original binary64 endpoint values, exact convex interpolation, one nearest-even conversion. Knot bytes including signed zero are preserved. Every sample repeats shared recipe beta admission.
schedulePolicy.rawSchema: Exactly profile, geometrySha256, complete ordered cellIds and knots; each knot contains fraction, targetsMeters and activation.
schedulePolicy.scope: No solver/adaptive execution or captured source admission; finite-grid coefficient admission alone does not prove forces, work, geometry or a trajectory.
schedulePolicy.witnessLimit: A selected plateau witness need not be the earliest full-grid minimizer. Per-cell minima may occur at different times; the assembled minima vector is only an admission probe. A deeper query is revalidated and is not covered by an earlier smaller grid preflight.

scope: Immutable supplied-cell parameter recipes, bounded target-first work and standalone immutable dyadic schedules; no varying-control solver integration.

verification.countPolicy: Focused methods overlap full discovery. The 243 exact arithmetic cases and 108 exhaustive finite-grid comparisons occur inside existing methods; 24 independent review probes are separate, not added to the unittest count.
scheduleCoverage: Maximum 4096 cells, 65 knots and 2^40 grid without enumeration
Original-fraction retries, round-to-even ties and signed zero
Capture, copies, explicit reinitialization and ndarray metadata mutation
workCoverage: Exact affine-radius polynomial oracle across 243 combinations
Four irrational roots with independent Decimal antiderivative
Four rational roots around interior collapse
Tiny work with equal rounded endpoint energies
Separate component tolerances and output rounding floors
Exact subnormal work retained by positive error enclosure
Cross-cell cancellation and nonnormalized anchor coefficients
Budget exhaustion and raw input rejection

workPolicy.boundary: The union of old/new quadratic taut margins has at most four mixed dyadic leaves per cell. U on a leaf of width h is bounded by h*max(0,max(Q-d^2))^2/(8*min(d)^2). Only margins referenced by nonzero work coefficients are partitioned.
workPolicy.cancellation: Shared polynomial/radial coefficients are combined before moment integration; matching (Q,lo,hi) groups combine across cells. Equal target functions combine before boundary bounding. Different partitions may retain conservative nonzero bounds for algebraically zero totals.
workPolicy.exactBeta: Beta is the exact product of admitted binary64 activation/density and rational measure. Endpoint positive beta requires a finite positive binary64 admission value; beta differences and work do not.
workPolicy.identity: Geometry binds original ordered cells excluding only targets/activation; parameter hashes bind normalized binary64 arrays separately from raw base/schedule provenance. Positions, both parameter sets, effective potentials and budgets are certified.
workPolicy.parameterOrder: Targets change at old activation at the same supplied positions, then activation changes at the new targets.
workPolicy.precision: Explicit total tolerance defaults to all five fields. A complete explicit mapping may give the four non-total fields separate tolerances. Output rounding is included. Unresolved arithmetic/output precision or exhausted budgets reject.
workPolicy.scope: Discrete work at one supplied state only; no continuous actuator work, motion, contact, calibration or source/joint acceptance.
workPolicy.smooth: Exact polynomial contributions plus bounded degree-zero/one square-root moments, using the unchanged radial kernel. Slack or collapsed zero-gap regions never normalize the gap.
workPolicy.workSum: Total is integrated directly. Independently rounded components need not sum bit-for-bit to the total. Total and each component retain separate error bounds.
